sentences.text: Researchers constructed a novel transistor combining specific inorganic oxides with a sputtering method, allowing the device to switch between short-term and long-term plasticity modes by adjusting gate voltage while maintaining constant light input.

Operating with a low read voltage of 1 mV and optical pulses of 0.0645 mW per square centimeter, the system preserved stable conductance levels and demonstrated short-term plasticity behaviors such as paired-pulse facilitation when a negative gate voltage was applied.

By tuning the gate, the transistor successfully powered a neural network to recognize handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset and analyze time-based signals comprising four frames, which the authors state solves limitations of older single-mode strategies.
